tagline: From Thread to Treasure — Textiles Woven for Everyday Luxury
about: The visionary behind ACR Cottons is dedicated to redefining home comfort through artisanal excellence. Operating out of Erode, Tamil Nadu (the Textile Valley of South India), ACR Cottons is a premium textile brand focused on crafting elegant, soft bedspreads, jacquard pillows, luxury pillowcases, and custom t-shirt printing. Founded by A.C. Raj Kumar, our collections bring a royal, peaceful feel to every home, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern luxury.
openingHours: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM, all working days except Saturday and Sunday

customPrinting.description: Customized T-shirt printing with live 3D/virtual visualizer, bio-washed cotton, and volume pricing.
